news.title: Pirates trade former No. 1 overall pick Davis to D-backs, sources say
news.summary: The Pirates are sending former No. 1 overall pick Henry Davis to Arizona in exchange for utility player Tim Tawa, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan

news.title: Chisholm reaches 1-year deal with Blue Jays, sources say
news.summary: The Blue Jays and second baseman Jazz Chisholm Jr. are in agreement on a one-year contract with an option for a second year that guarantees him $34.5 million, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Friday...

news.title: Cubs finalize deals with pitcher Rogers, outfielder Sato
news.summary: The Cubs have finalized their contracts with left-hander Trevor Rogers and Japanese outfielder Teruaki Sato.

news.title: Sources: Tigers stay busy, reach 1-year, $25M deal with RHP Gausman
news.summary: RHP Kevin Gausman and the Tigers have agreed to a one-year, $25M contract, pending a physical, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Wednesday.

news.title: Reports: Guardians bring back Griffin on 3-year, $48 million deal
news.summary: Pitcher Foster Griffin will return to the Guardians after agreeing to a three-year, $48 million contract, according to multiple reports.

news.title: Mets brass 'thrilled' to have Skubal in rotation for 'years to come'
news.summary: Tarik Skubal, a two-time Cy Young Award winner, has finalized a record $450 million, nine-year contract with the New York Mets.
